title: Ops Panorama CLI + Microplay Atomizer: convert runbooks into composable atomic tasks
creator: Olivia Chen
description: Build a lightweight CLI (Ops Panorama) and an 'Microplay Atomizer' backend that turns canonical runbooks into parameterized, auditable, and composable atomic tasks. These tasks can be executed interactively from the CLI or orchestrated via the support automation pipeline. Goal: reduce mean time to remediate (MTTR) for common SRE tasks, improve repeatability, and provide strong audit/permission controls for first-line responders.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can list available microplays and show typed input schema and permission level
Microplay Atomizer produces an idempotent task bundle with safety checks and a dry-run mode
Every execution creates audit events with runbook version, inputs, and outcome, viewable in the Console timeline
Integrates with existing RBAC so tasks requiring elevated permissions are gated and audited
Automated end-to-end test (simulated cluster) validates two core microplays: rotate-cache-key and restart-ganglia-proxy
comments: 2026-01-15: Spike complete. Prototype used Lua-like templating for steps; discovered templating complexity for conditional branches.
2026-01-29: Design review with PM and SRE. Decision: adopt explicit step-transition graph instead of freeform templates to simplify verification and dry-run semantics. Javier to PR DSL spec.
2026-02-10: Security flagged need for KMS/HSM call patterns and least-privilege preview. Added security_review_required flag and onboarding doc for reviewers.

2026-02-23: Implemented initial CLI scaffold and 'list' + 'describe' commands. UX feedback from Support: add examples and a 'simulate' mode that returns suggested remediation steps without side effects.
2026-03-02: Integration tests flaky around timeouts when atomizer talks to admin-agent; increased agent probe timeout and introduced exponential backoff. Monitoring ticket created (ENG-582999).
2026-03-10: Code review comments addressed (GH PR #1382). Requesting a cross-team review for telemetry schema before landing.
implementation_notes: Backend atomizer will emit a JSON task bundle: metadata, steps[], prechecks[], postchecks[]; each step has idempotency hint and compensation step
Choose synchronous step executor for interactive CLI flows, but emit events so orchestrator can run identical bundles asynchronously
Use existing admin-agent for privileged actions; introduce a mediation layer for KMS access to avoid secrets in bundles
Telemetry events follow 'ops.microplay.execution' schema; include runbook_version, initiated_by, agent_host, duration_ms, status, error_code
Plan to reuse Console timeline storage; small retention increase requested (release ops-tooling-2026.04)
Add feature flag for automated rollouts: feature.ops_panorama.enabled
rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal SRE-only rollout behind feature flag (2 weeks). Stage 2: support+oncall alpha group. Stage 3: broader support org. Gradual enablement of automation runners with circuit breakers and quota limits.
rollback_plan: Disable feature flag; revoke orchestration service account tokens; runbook executions are idempotent so partial runs can be retried. Postmortem if any durable config changes were applied.
monitoring: Alert: P1 if failure_rate > 5% for core microplays over 10m
Audit log stream to Console and to S3 for 90-day retention
